gettingStarted.title: Tempo.Blazor.Abstractions

items.description: Server-side (or async) data provider for TmDataTable. Implement this interface to power sorting, filtering, and pagination from an API or database. For in-memory scenarios, use InMemoryDataProvider<TItem> from Tempo.Blazor.

typeParameters.name: TItem
typeParameters.description: The item type returned by the provider.

methods.name: GetDataAsync
methods.description: Fetches a page of data applying the given query (sort, filter, search, page).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Query parameters including pagination, sorting, and filtering.

methods.name: GetGroupedDataAsync
methods.description: Fetches grouped data from the server with per-group pagination. Called when DataTableQuery.GroupByColumns is non-empty. Default implementation returns null, which causes the component to fall back to client-side grouping via GetDataAsync.

examples.title: API-based implementation
Usage in DataTable
examples.code:
<TmDataTable TItem="ProductDto" DataProvider="@_productProvider">
    <TmDataTableColumn Field="@(p => p.Name)" Title="Name" />
    <TmDataTableColumn Field="@(p => p.Price)" Title="Price" />
</TmDataTable>

@code {
    private IDataTableDataProvider<ProductDto> _productProvider = 
        new ApiDataProvider<ProductDto>(_api, "/api/products");
}

items.description: Represents a token/variable that can be inserted into TmRichEditor via the {{ trigger. Implement this interface to provide tokens with optional visual metadata (Icon, ColorClass, TypeLabel) that control how the chip is rendered in the editor and shown in the autocomplete dropdown.

properties.name: Key
properties.description: Unique key for the token used as its identifier in the editor HTML (e.g. "user.email", "company.name").

properties.name: DisplayName
properties.description: Human-readable name shown in the autocomplete list and rendered inside the {{ }} chip in the editor.

properties.name: Description
properties.description: Optional longer description shown below the key in the autocomplete dropdown and in hover preview args.

properties.name: Category
properties.description: Optional category used for grouping tokens in the autocomplete dropdown (e.g. "User", "System").

properties.name: Icon
properties.description: Optional icon shown next to the token in the dropdown and included in OnTokenHover args. Can be an emoji (e.g. "🔒") or a CSS icon class name.

properties.name: ColorClass
properties.description: Optional CSS class added to the token chip element in the editor for visual distinction. Built-in variants: "token-secret" (red), "token-url" (blue), "token-number" (green). Custom classes are also supported.

properties.name: TypeLabel
properties.description: Optional short type label shown as a badge in the dropdown and included in OnTokenHover args (e.g. "Secret", "URL", "Number").

examples.title: Basic IToken implementation
Tokens with visual metadata for different types

items.description: Data provider for the {{ token autocomplete in TmNotionEditor. Implement this interface to supply the list of available tokens (variables/fields) that users can insert by typing {{ in any text block.

properties.name: SupportsCreation
properties.description: When true the dropdown will offer a 'Create new token' action for queries that return no results. Return false for read-only token sets.

methods.name: SearchTokensAsync
methods.description: Returns tokens whose Key, DisplayName, Description, or Category contain the query string. Called each time the user types after {{ . An empty query returns all tokens.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: User's current search text (may be empty).

parameters.name: ct
parameters.description: Cancellation token — cancelled if the user types another character before the search completes.

methods.name: Refresh
methods.description: Invalidates any cached token data so the next search returns fresh results.

examples.title: Minimal token provider
Wiring to TmNotionEditor
examples.code:
@inject MyTokenProvider TokenProvider

<TmNotionEditor DataProvider="@DataProvider"
                BlockProvider="@BlockProvider"
                TokenProvider="@TokenProvider" />

items.description: Provides a set of WireframeComponentDef entries to the WireframeComponentRegistry. Built-in Tempo.Blazor components are registered via BuiltInWireframeComponentProvider (priority 0). Custom components are added by implementing this interface and calling services.AddWireframeComponentProvider<T>() in Program.cs. When two providers register the same Type, the one with the higher Priority wins.

methods.name: ProviderId
methods.description: Unique identifier for this provider (used in logging and override detection).

methods.name: Priority
methods.description: Higher priority wins when multiple providers register the same component type. Built-in uses 0; set > 0 to override.

methods.name: GetDefinitions
methods.description: Returns all component definitions supplied by this provider.

items.description: Event arguments passed to the OnTokenHover callback of TmRichEditorFull and TmRichEditorSimple when the user hovers over a token chip. Contains the full token metadata and the chip's bounding rect in client (viewport) coordinates so the application can position its own tooltip.

properties.name: Key
properties.description: Unique key of the hovered token (e.g. "user.email").

properties.name: DisplayName
properties.description: Display name of the token (e.g. "User Email").

properties.name: Description
properties.description: Optional description of the token.

properties.name: Category
properties.description: Optional category of the token.

properties.name: Icon
properties.description: Optional icon (emoji or CSS class) from the token's IToken.Icon property.

properties.name: ColorClass
properties.description: Optional CSS color class applied to the chip (e.g. "token-secret").

properties.name: TypeLabel
properties.description: Optional short type label (e.g. "Secret", "URL", "Number").

properties.name: RectLeft
properties.description: Left edge of the token chip in client (viewport) coordinates (px). Equivalent to getBoundingClientRect().left.

properties.name: RectTop
properties.description: Top edge of the token chip in client (viewport) coordinates (px).

properties.name: RectRight
properties.description: Right edge of the token chip in client (viewport) coordinates (px).

properties.name: RectBottom
properties.description: Bottom edge of the token chip in client (viewport) coordinates (px). Use this as the tooltip's top offset to position it just below the chip.

properties.name: RectWidth
properties.description: Width of the token chip (px).

properties.name: RectHeight
properties.description: Height of the token chip (px).

items.description: Describes a single component that can be placed on the wireframe canvas. Each Tempo.Blazor component (TmButton, TmDataTable, …) has exactly one definition registered via IWireframeComponentProvider. The RenderSvg delegate produces the SVG markup shown on the canvas. SizePresets maps size prop values to canonical W×H so that changing 'size' in the Properties Panel automatically resizes the element.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Unique type identifier matching WireframeElement.Type. E.g. 'TmButton'.

properties.name: Category
properties.description: Toolbox group. E.g. 'Buttons', 'Inputs', 'Layout', 'Custom'.

properties.name: DisplayName
properties.description: Human-readable name shown in the Toolbox and Properties Panel header.

properties.name: Icon
properties.description: TmIcon name used in the Toolbox list item.

properties.name: DefaultWidth
properties.description: Default element width when dropped from the Toolbox.

properties.name: DefaultHeight
properties.description: Default element height when dropped from the Toolbox.

properties.name: Props
properties.description: Property definitions that drive the Properties Panel UI.

properties.name: RenderSvg
properties.description: Delegate that renders the component's SVG shape. Coordinates are relative to the element's top-left (0, 0). The outer <g> transform is applied by the canvas.

properties.name: IsBuiltIn
properties.description: True for built-in Tempo.Blazor components; false for custom/JSON-defined ones.

properties.name: SizePresets
properties.description: Optional map from a 'size' prop value to canonical element dimensions. When present and the user changes the size prop, the canvas element is automatically resized. Null for components where 'size' describes an internal sub-element (e.g. TmModal dialog scale).

examples.title: Minimal custom component definition

items.description: Root model for a wireframe document. Contains the canvas dimensions, all placed elements, connectors, and metadata. Serialized to/from JSON via WireframeSerializer. Safe to use in API or service projects (no UI dependencies).

properties.name: Version
properties.description: Schema version. Used for forward-compatibility detection.

properties.name: Title
properties.description: Human-readable document title shown in the editor toolbar.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Canvas width in pixels.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Canvas height in pixels.

properties.name: Elements
properties.description: All placed component elements. Rendered in ZIndex order.

properties.name: Connectors
properties.description: Arrow/line connectors between elements.

properties.name: CreatedAt
properties.description: UTC timestamp when the document was created.

properties.name: ModifiedAt
properties.description: UTC timestamp of the last modification.

examples.title: Create a document with one button element

items.description: A single component instance placed on the wireframe canvas. Stores position, size, component type, and a property bag (Props) that maps to the component's PropDef definitions. Props is a Dictionary<string, JsonElement> allowing any value type. Helper extension methods (GetString, GetInt, GetBool, etc.) on WirframeElementExtensions simplify prop access.

properties.name: Id
properties.description: Unique element ID. Auto-generated as an 8-char hex string (Guid prefix).

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Component type identifier matching a WireframeComponentDef.Type (e.g. 'TmButton', 'TmDataTable').

properties.name: X
properties.description: Left edge in document coordinates (pixels).

properties.name: Y
properties.description: Top edge in document coordinates (pixels).

properties.name: W
properties.description: Width in pixels.

properties.name: H
properties.description: Height in pixels.

properties.name: Props
properties.description: Component property bag. Keys are camelCase prop names matching PropDef.Name.

properties.name: ZIndex
properties.description: Rendering order. Higher values render on top.

properties.name: GroupId
properties.description: Optional group identifier. Null = not grouped. Omitted from JSON when null.

properties.name: LockedBy
properties.description: Optional user identifier that has locked this element. Null = unlocked. Omitted from JSON when null.

examples.title: Create a button element with props
Read props safely

items.description: Serializes and deserializes WireframeDocument to/from JSON. Uses camelCase keys, indented output (for AI readability), and ignores null optional fields. Safe to use in API or service projects. The JSON format is the canonical interchange format for wireframe documents — suitable for storage, REST APIs, and AI prompt injection.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a WireframeDocument to indented camelCase JSON.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a WireframeDocument from JSON. Throws WireframeDeserializationException on failure.

methods.name: TryDeserialize
methods.description: Attempts to deserialize a WireframeDocument from JSON. Returns false (and out null) on failure instead of throwing.

parameters.name: document
parameters.description: Deserialized document, or null on failure.

jsonFormat.notes: Extra unknown fields are ignored (forward-compatible). All keys are camelCase.

examples.title: Serialize and store
examples.code:
var json = WireframeSerializer.Serialize(document);
await File.WriteAllTextAsync("layout.wireframe.json", json);

examples.title: Safe deserialization from API response
